question: Who is the next High Commissioner of India to the United Kingdom as announced in August 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vikram Doraiswami.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vikram Doraiswami:-**

 
 
• He is a career diplomat who has served in various Indian embassies and consulates around the world, including Bangladesh, Canada, China, and the United States.
 
• **The next High Commissioner of India to the United Kingdom is Vikram Doraiswami, as announced in August 2022. **
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ruchi Ghanashyam:- **

 
 
• **She is a high-ranking Indian bureaucrat who has served in a variety of positions, including as a Secretary at the Ministry of External Affairs and as the High Commissioner of India to the United Kingdom. **
 
 
 
• **Gaitri Issar Kumar:-**
 
 
• **She is a retired Indian Foreign Service officer from the 1986 batch. **
 
• Her last posting was as the High Commissioner of India to the United Kingdom.
 
 
 
• **Yashvardhan Kumar Sinha:-**
 
 
• **Yashvardhan Kumar Sinha is a retired Indian diplomat who served as the Chief Information Commissioner of India from 2020 to 2023. **
 
• He is a 1981 batch Indian Foreign Service officer.
